blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Panfilo Lacson on Monday described the 2027 budget consultation with civil society organization (CSO) representatives as “a big paradox.” “After hearing all the grievances and problems, you can’t help but ask, ‘Is there still hope for this country?” Lacson said. “On the other hand, after hearing their passion and their respective advocacies, you also begin to think, ‘There is great hope for our country.’ That’s the other side of the coin,” he added. Lacson made the statement as the Senate finance committee met with CSOs to discuss budget priorities for the 2027 General Appropriations Act. READ: Senate […]...
